tips.text: Run normal mode, not Steel Path; the Oni's damage attenuation makes clears two to four times slower for only a few extra Pearls.
Run until drops fill most of the set, then spend Pearls only on the blueprints still missing.
Pick up offerings during the Exterminate phase but hold them, then deliver both the moment the Oni loses its first bar; after The War Within the Operator can carry a second.
Bring crowd control for the two offering huts (Vauban, Khora, Mirage), since the delivery timer pauses while Infested stand in the radius.
Queue public; Koumei is an early-game frame, so other players often make the deliveries for you.
Kill the Undying Flyer pods; they pause the offering timer like any live enemy.
Bring Corrosive or Gas damage instead of Viral; Deimos Infested resist Viral and the Oni is immune to its status.
Skip resource boosters and Retriever mods here; they do not change the Fate Pearl payout.
Most players call this one of the easier recent farms; the complaint is the two-minute mission and loading-screen loop.
